params.q: What is the health cover amount per family under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?

search_parameters.q: What is the health cover amount per family under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?

response.header: Under Ayushman Bharat PM‑JAY, each eligible family receives ₹5 lakh of annual health cover on a family‑floater basis.

text_blocks.snippet: All authoritative sources confirm that PM‑JAY provides up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization:
snippet_highlighted_words: PM‑JAY provides up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year

list.snippet: Ditto Insurance states the scheme offers ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year on a family‑floater basis 1 .
snippet_highlighted_words: ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year

list.snippet: Sarkari Yojana notes ₹5 lakh free health cover per year for eligible families 1 .
snippet_highlighted_words: ₹5 lakh free health cover per year

list.snippet: Indian Pay Calculator also confirms ₹5 lakh per family per year 1 .
Economic Times reiterates ₹5 lakh per family per year 1 .
Ayushman Card Benefits 2026 lists ₹5,00,000 annual cashless cover per eligible family 1 .
snippet_highlighted_words: ₹5,00,000 annual cashless cover per eligible family

list.snippet: Haryana’s official PM‑JAY FAQ states cashless cover up to ₹5,00,000 per eligible family per annum 1 .
snippet_highlighted_words: cashless cover up to ₹5,00,000 per eligible family per annum

text_blocks.snippet: The ₹5 lakh is shared by the entire family, not allocated separately to each member. Any member can use the amount until the annual limit is exhausted Ditto Insurance+1 .

While the base family cover remains ₹5 lakh, senior citizens aged 70+ receive an additional ₹5 lakh top‑up under the Ayushman Vay Vandana expansion (if already part of a PM‑JAY family) Ditto Insurance+2 . This does not change the standard family cover amount—it adds a separate pool for eligible seniors.
